description: This file defines an interface for a cache that manages grain directory entries within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for adding, removing, clearing, and looking up cache entries, as well as a collection of key-value-version tuples. Additionally, it provides extension methods for simplified lookups.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryCache
classes.description: An interface for managing cache entries of grain directory data, supporting adding, removing, clearing, and lookup operations.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryCacheExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for the IGrainDirectoryCache interface, including simplified lookup functionality.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds a new entry with a specified version into the cache or updates an existing one, overwriting regardless of version.

methods.name: Remove (GrainId key)
methods.description: Removes a cache entry identified by a GrainId key.

methods.name: Remove (GrainAddress key)
methods.description: Removes a cache entry identified by a GrainAddress key.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: LookUp
methods.description: Retrieves the cached GrainAddress and version associated with a given GrainId key, returning true if found.
